paper_title: Joint Detection of Fraud and Concept Drift inOnline Conversations with   LLM-Assisted Judgment
caption: A runtime comparison between our ensemble model and various LLM models on the SEconvo dataset
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates a runtime comparison of different models in a streaming environment. The horizontal axis contains model categories, and the axis is labeled with model names: "Our Joint Framework", "ChatGPT", "DeepSeek", "LLaMA", and "Claude". The vertical axis represents runtime in seconds, labeled as "Runtime (seconds)" with a scale ranging from 0 to 400, marked with intervals of 50. There are two colors used in the chart: green for "Our Joint Framework" and blue for the LLM models. The green bar for "Our Joint Framework" has an approximate value or length of 77 seconds. The blue bars for the LLM models have the following approximate values or lengths: ChatGPT at 190 seconds, DeepSeek at 365 seconds, LLaMA at 172 seconds, and Claude at 243 seconds. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
